name: dumbbell lying triceps extension on floor
description: A floor version of the lying triceps extension, where the floor limits how far you lower the weight.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop just before the weights touch the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
